Question 3
?

Let f(x,y) be a function that is differentiable at each point on the line segment AB―, where a=⟨−3,5⟩ and b=⟨2,1⟩ are the position vectors of A and B, respectively. If f(a)=−2 and f(b)=4, then according to the mean value theorem, which of the following must be true for some point C∈AB― with position vector c?

a
5fx(c)+3fy(c)=2
b
3fx(c)+2fy(c)=6
c
3fx(c)−fy(c)=−2
d
5fx(c)−4fy(c)=6
e
fx(c)−6fy(c)=−2
